suggestions.msg: Pure documentation file listing 120 review guidelines organized into 12 categories; no executable code to evaluate.
json.JSONDecoder() is instantiated inside the for-loop fallback scan, creating a new object on every iteration instead of once before the loop.
suggestions.suggestion: Move `decoder = json.JSONDecoder()` to a line before the `for idx, char in enumerate(text)` loop.

suggestions.msg: All per-file results in run_batch_review store a reference to the same `output` str; this is safe for str (immutable) but misleading and risks turning into a shared-mutable aliasing bug if the code is later changed to collect output per-result.
suggestions.suggestion: Append per-file results with `output: output` as done now, but document explicitly or refactor so each result carries only its relevant slice (e.g., only `parsed`). Alternatively, drop `output` from per-file entries in batch mode since `parsed_by_file` already carries the parsed data.

suggestions.msg: github_api() returns `Any`, losing all type specificity from the GitHub API response shapes.
suggestions.suggestion: Replace `Any` return type with a TypedDict or a union of known response shapes (e.g., `CommentResponse | PRResponse | list[dict[str, Any]]`).

suggestions.msg: resolve_base_with_fallback() falls back to HEAD~1 but raises uncaught IndexError when HEAD has no parent (first commit on a branch), making that fallback unreachable.
suggestions.suggestion: Wrap the HEAD~1 fallback in a try/except IndexError, or add a comment documenting that callers must ensure HEAD has at least one parent.

suggestions.msg: extract_json_list and extract_json_object share nearly identical fallback scanning logic (raw_decode loop over text chars); duplication violates DRY and makes maintenance error-prone.
suggestions.suggestion: Extract the fallback scan into a helper: `def _find_json_in_text(text: str, open_char: str) -> Any | None` and call it from both functions.
